# Overview of Session 1 {#sec-s1}

Every business decision starts with numbers: what a product costs, what you charge, how much tax goes on top, and how prices change. In this session you refresh the arithmetic behind all of that and use it to build the price sheet for your own business.

::: {.goals}
Goals

After this session you can:

- calculate in the right order with whole numbers, negative numbers and decimals, and round money correctly;
- simplify, add, multiply and divide fractions, and use them for shares, ratios and prorated amounts;
- work with percentages: VAT, discounts, markup and margin, and percent change;
- use the rules for powers and roots, for example to turn a growth rate over several years into a yearly rate;
- use the binomial formulas to expand and factorise expressions.
:::

## Before class

- [ ] Work through the chapters of this session: @sec-arithmetic to @sec-binomial (about 75 minutes, videos included).
- [ ] Try the questions in @sec-s1-practice (about 20 minutes).
- [ ] Take **Entry quiz 1** on Moodle before the deadline.

**If you want more explanation or practice** (optional), the same topics are covered in @olivier2023, sec. 2.1–2.4, pp. 11–45, and also in @olivier2023, sec. 3.1, pp. 66–76 and @mazur2021, sec. 1.3 and 1.5–1.6, pp. 53–74 and 95–146. In German: @gundlach2024, sec. 1.1–1.2, pp. 13–20.

## In class

| Time | What happens |

Could not prepare? Start with the [catch-up sheet](catch-up.qmd) and join your group for problem set B.
